name: IF
description: IF performs a logical test and returns one value if true and another if false.
tldr: IF checks a condition and returns different values based on whether it is true or false.

parameters.name: logical_test
parameters.description: The condition to test (must evaluate to TRUE or FALSE).

parameters.name: value_if_true
parameters.description: The value to return if the condition is TRUE.

parameters.name: value_if_false
parameters.description: Optional. The value to return if the condition is FALSE.

basicExample.explanation: Returns "Over budget" if A1 > 100, otherwise "Within budget".

advancedExamples.title: Nested IF statements
advancedExamples.description: Handle multiple conditions with nested IFs
advancedExamples.explanation: Assigns letter grades based on score ranges.

advancedExamples.title: IF with AND/OR
advancedExamples.explanation: Checks if both values are positive using AND.

howItWorks: IF evaluates the logical test. If TRUE, it returns value_if_true; if FALSE, it returns value_if_false (or FALSE if omitted).

howToSteps.name: Define condition
howToSteps.text: Determine the logical test you want to perform.

howToSteps.name: Set true result
howToSteps.text: Decide what to return if the condition is TRUE.

howToSteps.name: Set false result
howToSteps.text: Decide what to return if the condition is FALSE.

limitations: Nested IFs can become hard to read beyond 3-4 levels.
For multiple conditions, consider using IFS function instead.

commonErrors.cause: Logical test does not evaluate to TRUE/FALSE
commonErrors.fix: Check your condition returns a boolean value.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: IF works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Can IF return formulas?
faq.answer: Yes, IF can return any value including formulas.

faq.question: What happens if value_if_false is omitted?
faq.answer: IF returns FALSE when the condition is FALSE and value_if_false is omitted.
